prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a two-storey house in a stone-and-plaster harbour town on a windy northern coast. blue-grey slate roof with overlapping slates and a ridge red-brown brick walls with stone corners. Windows have small panes glowing warm amber from inside (the only light). The whole image is 176 x 224 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: Edit the ATTACHED layout guide into ONE finished standalone building sprite, exact same 1232x1568 canvas corresponding to 176x224 art pixels at precisely 7x nearest-neighbor scaling. Use the attached image as a STRICT pixel-level placement/layout template. Transparent alpha outside the building, replacing all magenta with full transparency. Keep precise building silhouette: roof x=14..1218 y=196..938, façade x=56..1176 y=939..bottom; preserve roof's horizontal internal seam around y=523 and roof-to-wall line y=939. Roof seen from above, lower front façade seen straight-on (classic JRPG 3/4 overhead view); no perspective vanishing or peaked frontal roof. Preserve the four existing amber-glowing window rectangles in EXACT original positions/sizes (upper row approximately x336..448 and 770..882, y1036..1177; lower row same x, y1344..1485), embellish WITHIN with dark sash and little panes. Preserve any dark brown door in source at precisely its original ground-level position and dimensions; if it is absent from visible guide, add a small actual walk-through dark-brown front door centered on the façade at ground level extending to bottom edge, without moving windows. Two-storey windy northern harbour-town house: blue-grey overlapping slate courses on the roof, subtle ridge and crisp eaves; red-brown brick and weathered plaster façade with stone quoin corners, small restrained architectural details. Windows are the ONLY emitted light, warm amber behind panes. Premium modern hi-bit 2D JRPG pixel art, crisp uniform hard-edged 7x7 square image pixels throughout with hand-placed cohesive clusters 3–10 art pixels, absolutely no antialiasing/blurring/gradients/noise/dithering/checkerboarding. Earthy 4–6 tone hue-shifted ramps: purple-red shadows and warm-yellow highlights. Soft neutral even overcast illumination from upper left, clean base colors, no night darkness, cast shadows, light pools, ground, people, signage, letters, or vignette. Keep top margin transparent; optional tiny chimney only if it doesn't affect established building outline elsewhere.
